newer_practice.summary: Python 3.15 preserves this comparison behavior. Its release on 2026-10-09 was verified on the [official release page](https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-3150/), accessed 2026-10-10. This is reinforcing context, not a superseding rule, and does not change this step.

recommended_action: No change required to the evaluator claim. Independently applying the documented rule establishes that both timestamps denote the same instant. Retain its fixed-offset qualification; this confirmation does not establish that local code parses or compares them correctly.
